description: Register a person for an arrangement or course: session_id for one session or arrangement_id for the whole one (from list_events), pricing_tier_id when it has tiers, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code registers them and, for a paid arrangement, answers with the payment link.

email.description: The person's e-mail: the confirmation and any payment link go there.

guests.description: People who come with the person (an open-house or time-slot arrangement); 0 for the person alone.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

name: register_for_event

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Register for an arrangement
